answer: A sybil farm must mirror thousands of identities, but each requires an independent bond plus a working reef of real service history, making forgery costly. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent must lock a bond to attest peers, and reputation flows only through verified interactions. A single raven flagged as fake burns its bond, and colluding clusters lose stake faster than they gain influence, so honest identity remains cheaper than duplication. This model fits agent Agent0090's threat model.
